evidence: PubMed (efetch, PMID 3567305): 'Biometrics. 1987 Mar;43(1):207-11. ... Connor RJ.' Abstract: 'A simple alternative approximation that is more conservative is presented here.' Crossref (10.2307/2531961) and Semantic Scholar give the author as 'Robert J. Connor', not 'Roger J. Connor'. Primary full text (JSTOR) is closed and was not read. The formula is taken from the Stata PSS manual ('power pairedproportions', Methods and formulas, p. 21), which states 'See Connor (1987) for details': n = [ (z_alpha*sqrt(p_disc) + z_{1-beta}*sqrt(p_disc - p_diff^2)) / p_diff ]^2, with p_disc = p12 + p21 (discordant proportion) and p_diff = p21 - p12; for a two-sided test use alpha/2 (Stata then iterates on the exact two-sided power equation).
correction: Author is Robert J. Connor (Biometrics 43(1):207-211, March 1987). Claim: Connor gives a simple, more conservative approximation than Miettinen (1968) for the paired-proportions sample size; n = [z_{1-alpha(/2)} sqrt(psi) + z_{1-beta} sqrt(psi - delta^2)]^2 / delta^2, psi = p10 + p01, delta = p10 - p01. Mark the formula as 'as given in the Stata PSS manual, attributed to Connor (1987)' unless the JSTOR text is read. The dependence on discordant probabilities (not marginals alone) is supported by this formula.
location: PubMed abstract; Stata PSS-2 manual 'power pairedproportions', Methods and formulas, eq. (3), p. 21
